text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — after the morning model push to rwd-3.2, we've had several customer reports that the onboarding assistant sounds noticeably colder and shorter. Noticed drop in emoji and more directive phrasing. Not a crash but impacting conversion.

Sam Lin: thanks for flagging. Can you attach a before/after sample and the request id(s)? Also which endpoint and model param were used?

Priya Rao: Using chat/completions, model switched from rwd-3.1 to rwd-3.2. Minimal repro below.

Request (same for both):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "rwd-3.2",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Write a warm, friendly welcome message for new users of our productivity app."}],
  "temperature": 0.35,
  "max_tokens": 90
}
```

Sample (rwd-3.1 - cached):
"Hey 👋 Welcome to TaskSpring! We're thrilled you're here. Start with the 'Quickstart' to set up your first project — and ping us anytime."

Sample (rwd-3.2 - live, req id req_20251115_9c7d):
"Welcome to TaskSpring. See the Quickstart and create a project to begin. Contact support if needed."

Priya Rao: multiple users literally used the word "robotic" in feedback and onboarding completions dipped ~2.8% today.

Sam Lin: escalating. Creating ticket SUP-12867 and assigning to eng triage. @Jamie Ortega can you own the initial analysis?

Jamie Ortega: on it. Quick question: was rwd-3.2 intentionally tuned for conciseness/safety? @Olivia Chen any release notes about style changes?

Olivia Chen: release notes mention "conciseness and safety adjustments to reduce hallucination and overall token usage". No explicit friendliness tuning. Rollout: canary 09:58 UTC, full 13:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout of rwd-3.2 completed to 100% at 2025-11-15T13:45:12Z

Jamie Ortega: ran an A/B sweep across our onboarding prompt set. High-level:
- avg token count: rwd-3.2 down ~15%
- emoji usage: ~95% fewer emojis
- formality classifier: +0.20 shift toward formal
- hallucinations: slight decrease (~2%)

Conclusion: the change is consistent with the conciseness/safety tweak pruning friendly asides.

Nora Patel: CS says customers want the prior tone back ASAP. Can we provide an immediate client-side mitigation?

Jamie Ortega: yes — prepending a brief system role prompting for warmth recovers most of the friendliness. Example system prefix:
```
System: "You are a friendly, upbeat assistant. Use casual language and occasional emojis. Keep responses helpful and warm."
```
With that prefix on rwd-3.2 we get outputs very close to rwd-3.1 voice; token count is still slightly lower (~8%). You can also nudge temperature to 0.4 and increase max_tokens if needed.

Priya Rao: we can deploy that client-side, but this is a brittle workaround. Would prefer a platform-side option.

Sam Lin: action items:
- Sam -> DM Priya exact system prefix and suggested param tweaks
- Olivia/Jamie -> product + eng to add a "voice profile" toggle in hosted console/SDKs (short-term opt-in)
- Product -> consider targeted rollback windows for impacted paying customers
- Eng -> add style regression checks to release pipeline

Jamie Ortega: repro script I used (internal):
```
for m in rwd-3.1 rwd-3.2; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
    -d '{"model":"'$m'","messages":[{"role":"system","content":""},{"role":"user","content":"Write a warm, friendly welcome message for new users of our productivity app."}],"temperature":0.35,"max_tokens":90}'
  echo; sleep 0.2
done
```

Jamie Ortega: logs show rwd-3.2 traffic flagging from canary at 2025-11-15T09:58:xxZ and full rollout 2025-11-15T13:45:12Z.

Olivia Chen: product stance: because hallucinations decreased, we won't blanket-roll back. We'll ship a hosted "voice profile" within two weeks and permit emergency targeted rollbacks for customers suffering measurable harm. Also adding "style checks" to release QA.

Priya Rao: OK. We'll apply the prefix for now. Please mark SUP-12867 as P2 and escalate rollback if conversion or NPS keeps drifting.

Sam Lin: DM'ing the prefix and recommended params now. Ticket updated. Will reopen thread if we decide to rollback. :thumbsup:

Jamie Ortega: follow-up for eng: consider automated style/unit tests for friendly/onboarding prompts during model upgrades so we catch regressions earlier.

Olivia Chen: added to release checklist and product acceptance criteria.

Priya Rao: thanks all — applying prefix now and will report back on metrics in 24 hours. Appreciate the quick triage. :relieved:
